                           ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 7-G in the area bounded by


       West Nelson Street; a line 125 feet east of and parallel to North
       Southport Avenue; a line 24 feet south of and parallel to West
       Nelson Street; and North Southport Avenue,


to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Tovmhouse and Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
